item.coloph: de ltar dam nyams 'gug sgrol srog gshed 'di/ ma 'gags thabs kyi las mtha' tshogs pa dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan pa'i phyir du ni/ dam can rgya mtsho'i mchod gzhung gtsor bton te/ skyam nam ming gis brtsams par bgyis pa la/ 'gal 'khrul nongs gyur ma cig thugs la bzod/ sgrab gshen mthu dbang ldan zhing bstan pa dar/ sems can bde skyid tshogs pa'i cha rkyen du/ bkra shis dpal 'bar pad mo 'dab rgyas shog/
